subject: science
passage: Greenland sharks swim slowly through the cold, dark waters of the North Atlantic and Arctic Oceans. Because the sharks lack hard bones that record yearly growth, scientists estimated their ages by dating proteins in the lenses of their eyes, which form before birth. Growing only about a centimeter each year, ______ The same study suggested that some individuals live for more than 270 years.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

choices.A: the sharks may need around 150 years to reach adulthood, scientists concluded.
choices.B: scientists concluded that the sharks may need around 150 years to reach adulthood.
choices.C: around 150 years may be needed for the sharks to reach adulthood, scientists concluded.
choices.D: the sharks' adulthood may take around 150 years to arrive, scientists concluded.

explanation.why: The introductory phrase "Growing only about a centimeter each year" describes the sharks. A modifier at the start of a sentence applies to the subject that comes right after the comma, so that subject must be "the sharks."
explanation.A: Correct. "The sharks" comes right after the introductory phrase, so it is clear that the sharks are the ones growing slowly.
explanation.B: Incorrect. This makes "scientists" the subject, so the sentence says the scientists grow about a centimeter each year.
explanation.C: Incorrect. The subject here is "around 150 years," so the sentence says a period of time is growing.
explanation.D: Incorrect. The subject here is "adulthood," not the sharks; adulthood does not grow a centimeter a year.
